title: Enemies
description: Enemy definitions, keyed by enemy id. Units are Quake units, seconds, and degrees.

classname.description: Map entity classname that spawns this enemy; must be defined in the FGD.

eye_height.description: Eye position above the origin, for line-of-sight checks.

think_interval.description: Time between AI decisions. Each enemy also gets a per-enemy offset.

turn_speed.description: How fast it turns toward where it's going, in degrees per second (Quake's yaw_speed: a grunt's 20 per think is 200).

sight_range.description: Furthest distance at which the player can be noticed.

field_of_view.description: Full view cone width, in degrees.

reaction_delay.description: Delay between first sighting the player and acting.

fights_own_kind.description: Whether it turns on another enemy of its own type that hurts it. Enemies of different types always do (Quake's infighting; Quake's grunts fight their own kind too).

windup.description: Time from starting an attack to firing, standing and facing the target (Quake's grunt fires 0.4 s into its attack).

cooldown.description: Time from firing until it may attack again.

aim_lag.description: It aims where the target was this long ago (from the target's velocity), so moving targets are harder to hit (Quake's grunt: 0.2).

stun.description: How long a flinch stops the enemy acting.
